## Checklist

- [ ] Acceptance criteria met and demonstrated on staging
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `php artisan test` passes
- [ ] PHPStan level 8 clean
- [ ] Authorisation enforced server-side (policies), not only in the UI
- [ ] Minor/consent restrictions respected where this touches messaging, requests or posting
- [ ] Audit logging added for administrative or moderation actions
- [ ] Responsive from 360 px; WCAG 2.1 AA contrast and labels
- [ ] Documentation / OpenAPI updated
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or real user data committed
